frames.name: Public site frame
frames.purpose: Around the landing, sign-up and sign-in pages, for a reader who is not signed in.
steps: Sees the logo, which leads to /.
Can choose Sign in, which goes to /sign-in, or Get started, which goes to /sign-up.

alternatives.when: the screen is as narrow as a phone
steps: Sees the logo and a menu button.
Can open the menu to choose Sign in or Get started.

frames.name: App frame
frames.purpose: Around every page a signed-in reader uses.
steps: Sees the logo, which leads to /books.
Can open the account menu, which shows their email and lets them sign out (F06).

screens.title: Keep track of what to read next
screens.purpose: A visitor learns what Shelf does and starts using it.
steps: Reads the title and a sentence on what Shelf does: one private list of the books to read, being read and finished.
Can choose Get started, which goes to /sign-up.
Can choose Sign in, which goes to /sign-in.

screens.title: Create your account
screens.purpose: A visitor creates an account to keep a private reading list.
steps: Fills in the email (FD01) and the password (FD02).
Can choose Create account, which signs them in and goes to /books.
Can choose Sign in instead, which goes to /sign-in.

alternatives.when: the email already has an account
steps: Sees that the email already has an account.
Can choose Sign in, which goes to /sign-in.

screens.title: Sign in
screens.purpose: A reader gets back to their reading list.
steps: Fills in the email (FD01) and the password (FD02).
Can choose Sign in, which goes to /books.

alternatives.when: the email and password match no account
steps: Sees that they don't match an account, with the email kept.
Can try again.

screens.title: Reading list
screens.purpose: The reader sees every book they keep and finds the one they want.
steps: Sees the title "Reading list" and how many books it holds.
Can search the list by title or author.
Sees each book's title, author and shelf (FD03, FD04, FD05), newest first.
Can choose Add a book, which opens D01.
Can open a book, which goes to /books/[bookId].

alternatives.when: the reader has no books yet
steps: Reads that the list is empty and that books they add show up here.
Can choose Add a book, which opens D01.
Reads that no book matches the search.
Can clear the search.

screens.title: The book's title
screens.purpose: The reader looks at one book and can delete it.
steps: Sees the book's title, author and shelf (FD03, FD04, FD05).
Can choose Delete, which opens D02.
Can go back to /books.

alternatives.when: the book was deleted in the meantime
steps: Reads that the book is gone.
Can go back to /books.

dialogs.title: Add a book
dialogs.purpose: The reader adds a book to the reading list.
steps: Fills in the Book form (FM01): the title, the author and the shelf.
Can choose Save, which adds the book and shows it first in the reading list.
Can choose Cancel, which closes the dialog and saves nothing.
Sees that the book wasn't saved, with the values kept.
Can choose Save again.

dialogs.title: Delete this book?
dialogs.purpose: The reader confirms deleting a book.
steps: Reads that the book will be removed from the reading list.
Can choose Delete, which deletes the book and goes back to /books.
Can choose Cancel, which closes the dialog and changes nothing.
